title: A completed focused launcher run stays registrationState=discovered / trackingDurability=unconfirmed, so its result is never credited to the held item
outcome: A completed focused launcher run stays registrationState=discovered / trackingDurability=unconfirmed, so its result is never credited to the held item
acceptance: A focused launcher run that completes and delivers its terminal result to the caller is represented in /api/test-runs with a confirmed registration and tracking state bound to the caller's held work and source fingerprint, or the host reports a specific, typed reason why it is not.
A regression test reproduces a completed focused run whose host record remains discovered/unconfirmed and shows the corrected state or the typed reason.
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
